notes.title: V.31.0
notes.notes:
[p]Three years ago, I made the decision to keep all games in the Barro franchise updated, including the older titles. This choice allowed the first game in the series to receive nearly 100 updates since its release — a milestone that makes the continuous addition of new content and improvements possible.[/p][p]With this new update, all games in the Barro series are now moving to the latest version. The fixes and changes made to the online multiplayer mode in [i]Barro GT[/i] are now also available in the other versions, ensuring consistency and improvements across the board.[/p][p]Optimizations have been made to game loading, which should result in faster startup times and reduced disk usage for some versions.[/p][p]Since this update brings significant changes, we kindly ask that any issues be reported on the community forum. This helps us identify and resolve any instability quickly.[/p][p]Lastly, we apologize for posting the same announcement across all games in the series. We understand it may seem repetitive, but it’s necessary for Steam to properly track updates for each title.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you for continuing to play. ːb22_upː[/p]

Several improvements have been made to the online multiplayer mode, but most notably there is an improvement to the faster versions of the game (Barro F/F22/F25).

With this update, the driveability for the client should be much closer to that of the host, making the competition fairer.

If you see any bugs or something that shouldn't be happening, please use the game forums to report it. ːb22_upː

notes.title: Open Playtest
notes.notes:
[h1]Open Playtest – Join Us[/h1]

We invite all players to participate in the Open Playtest of our racing game. This is an opportunity to experience the features we're developing and contribute to their improvement.

[h2]Playtest Details:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Open to everyone interested.
[*]Available modes: Time Trial and Multiplayer Online.
[*]Access to a limited selection of cars and racing tracks.
[/list]

Why Participate? We're testing the new Multiplayer Online mode. Your participation will help identify and fix potential issues during this early development stage.

[b]Important Note: [/b]The Multiplayer Online mode is in its initial phase, so errors may occur. Please report any issues on the community forum, where your feedback will be reviewed by our team.

We appreciate your support as we work to enhance the gaming experience.

notes.title: [V.29.12] New online multiplayer mode available
notes.notes:
[h2]New Online Multiplayer Mode[/h2]
We are excited to introduce the new online multiplayer mode, bringing a new dimension to the game.

[h2]Play with Your Friends[/h2]
The experience is much more enjoyable with friends! Since there are currently few players searching for matches, we recommend inviting your friends to play. To do this, simply send an invite through Steam while the game is open.

[h2]Playing with Random Players[/h2]
You can also play with random players by creating a lobby. However, to ensure a better experience, we suggest prioritizing matches with friends because we don't have too many people playing the game.

[h2]Starting Grid Definition[/h2]
The starting grid in the new mode is determined by the time recorded on the leaderboard.

[h2]Initial Alpha Version[/h2]
Please note that this is an initial alpha release, which means errors may occur. If you encounter any issues, we kindly ask you to use the community forum to report them and help improve the game.

[h2]Community Contribution[/h2]
Community support is essential! If you find any errors or have suggestions, please use the community forum. Your participation is crucial for continuous development.
